objective: change one value in a large file without touching the rest

worker.instructions: `/in/seed/data.txt` has 400 lines of the form `key_<n>=<n>`. Copy it into your workspace and change the value of `key_237` from 237 to 9990, changing **nothing else** — every other line must stay byte-identical. Read files from /in/seed/ (read-only); your own /workspace is writable. When the task is done, call final_result alone with a short summary and route `done`.

seed.run: sh -c "i=1; while [ $i -le 400 ]; do printf 'key_%s=%s\n' "$i" "$i"; i=$((i + 1)); done > data.txt"
